import json
from pathlib import Path
terms=('retire','removal','verdict'); subjects=('software-award','open-software','sqlite')
for path in sorted(Path('world/pages').glob('missions-*.json')):
    data=json.loads(path.read_text())
    rows=data if isinstance(data,list) else next((data[k] for k in ('items','missions','entries','records','data') if isinstance(data.get(k),list)),[])
    print(json.dumps({'page':str(path),'rows':len(rows),'keys':list(data) if isinstance(data,dict) else None}))
    for row in rows:
        name=row.get('mission_id','').lower()
        if any(term in name for term in terms) and any(subject in name for subject in subjects):
            print(json.dumps({k:row.get(k) for k in ('mission_id','status','agent_id','evidence')}))
